limitations.quote: I’ll update each binary pointer and its Gray encoding on the same accepted operation
limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the write increment but also aligned the binary and Gray updates, registered the status flags, and gated RAM access during reset, changing cycle-by-cycle behavior that the reference fix preserves.
The rewrite changed the supplied RAM’s address ports from two bits to one at DEPTH=1, although TopModule’s external ports were preserved.

The scoreboard used the DUT’s own flags to decide which requests counted, so its data-order and boundary checks could pass without detecting changes to the exact cycles when full and empty assert or clear.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command prevented the first test launch and forced the agent to rebuild the launcher, after a separate Git check had already failed because the workspace was not a repository.

limitations.quote: For synchronous FIFO debugging, compare when pointers advance with when RAM samples its address.
limitations.note: The synchronous-FIFO entries did not help the agent distinguish the malformed write increment from the asynchronous pointer and flag timing that the expected fix preserves.
